services.name: Kayak
services.desc: Issaquah, WA - Lake Sammamish Paddle Co. & Outfitters by Wheel Fun Rentals is inviting outdoor enthusiasts to experience the beauty of Lake Sammamish like never before with the launch of its new Guided Kayak Tours. Led by experienced local guides, these relaxing on-the-water excursions offer guests an unforgettable opportunity to explore the lake’s peaceful shoreline, abundant wildlife, and breathtaking Pacific Northwest scenery. Launching from Tibbetts Beach in Lake Sammamish State Park, these guided tours are perfect for beginners and experienced paddlers alike. blurb: Guests can rent a variety of specialty cycles, cruiser bikes, surreys, electric bikes, swan pedal boats, kayaks, canoes, and stand-up paddleboards. Rentals are available at locations including Long Beach (Rainbow Lagoon, Shoreline Village) and Minneapolis (Lake Nokomis). Night rides with LED-lit surreys and swan boats are offered seasonally. Parking validation is available at some locations.
